The '''Marmoth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marmoth]].
